$comment: Differential fuzz corpus for the M1 selector matcher (PLAN.md 7.3). Documents and selectors are generated from a fixed seed and every expected answer comes from upstream RxDB in Node, never from the Rust matcher. `$present` records which fields are actually present on each document, because absent-versus-null is the classic Mango divergence and JSON alone cannot express it once a key is gone.

determinism.mathRandom: xorshift128 seeded with 0x5eed1e55, 1 draw per call
determinism.dateNow: frozen monotonic clock starting at 1700000000000, +1 ms per call
